Sub:- Sub-optimal disposal of 14-B Cases-Reg.
Sir/Madam,

I am directed to inform that a review of pending cases of damages U/S
14-B of the Act as on 31.01.2021 was made at the Head Office and it was
observed that:

a. 1967 cases are pending for more than five years and out of which 1423
cases (i.e., 72%) are pending at RO, Cochin in Kerala and Lakshadweep
Zone;

b. 1205 cases are pending between three to five years and out of which 492
cases (i.e., 41%) are pending in Mumbai -I Zone;

c. 9314 cases are pending between one to three years and out of which 3891
cases (i.e., 41.8%) are pending at RO, Ranchi in Bihar & Jharkhand Zone.

Z. A comprehensive review of all functional areas of Compliance is
requested by a regular and periodical monitoring of ROs under your
jurisdiction. A concerted effort to dispose off all such cases of damages U/S 14-
B, which are pending for more than one year, by 31.03.2021.

Yours faithfully,

afc)
(P. ‘aj Raman)
